name: EarMen
_refused: Read 2026-11-25 and refused. The prohibiting clause: « You may not reproduce, duplicate, copy, sell, resell or exploit any part of the Service without our written permission. » And a second, independently sufficient one: « You may not use the website or Service for unlawful, fraudulent, deceptive, abusive, infringing or harmful purposes; to transmit malware; to collect personal information unlawfully; to spam, phish or scrape; to bypass security measures; or to interfere with the website, servers, systems or business. » The terms claim the whole site, not a shop: « This website is operated by EarMen LLC. [...] EarMen provides this website, including all information, tools, products and services available through it, subject to your acceptance of these Terms of Service » Host finding first: earmen.net does NOT resolve (NXDOMAIN), nor do www.earmen.net, earmen-audio.com or earmen.eu; earmen-shop.com returns 301 to earmen.com with « x-redirect-reason: primary_domain_redirection ». The maker's own site is earmen.com, a Shopify storefront whose terms name the operator: « This website is operated by EarMen LLC. » Product pages are at earmen.com/products/…, the same host. Worth noting that this is a REWRITTEN terms document, shorter and differently worded from the Shopify template Hidizs uses - so the prohibition is deliberate text rather than inherited default language. NO copyright notice exists anywhere: the terms page and the 311 kB homepage were searched for the copyright sign, the entity, « copyright » and « all rights reserved », with zero matches, and the footer block was inspected directly. The absence of a footer notice does not weaken the explicit clause. robots.txt is the same stock Shopify file, no Content-Signal, no Claude group. No product page was opened and no record will exist under this brand.
_it_can_be_lifted: Both clauses are conditioned on written permission - « without express written permission by us » for Hidizs, « without our written permission » for EarMen. So this is a permission request, not a dead end, and the brand belongs on the letter list rather than among the permanent gaps. What is lost meanwhile: for EarMen, the per-input ceilings of the Tradutto, Angel and CH-Amp, which are desktop units with real optical, coaxial and Bluetooth inputs; for Hidizs, a range of dongles and players that state DSD transports more often than most.
